# Common reclaim bin retired sheet

Deprecated: before the stream split this sheet directed both pale and dark offcuts to common bin C. Bin C is no longer a reclaim destination. The [separated streams sheet](reclaim-streams.md) is the current source.

## Archive interpretation
A historical C entry refers to a mixed preparation whose shade ancestry cannot be reconstructed by inventing separate P and D tickets.
